description: Record a holding the user already owns: a security (ISIN preferred; an exact ticker or a name also works) and a quantity, in one of their portfolios. Never buys or sells. If the name matches several securities the tool returns the candidates — ask the user which, then call again with that ISIN. Modification Plan flow: call without confirm to get a plan, show plan.human_message to the user, and only if they approve call again with confirm=true and plan_id. For bonds, quantity is the nominal.
name: add_position
title: Add position
